verses.textZh: 论到太初就已经存在的生命之道，就是我们所听见，亲眼所看见，仔细观察过，亲手摸过的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到太初就已经存在的生命之道，就是我们所听见，亲眼所看见，仔细观察过，亲手摸过的；
verses.textZhCuv: 论到从起初原有的生命之道，就是我们所听见、所看见、亲眼看过、亲手摸过的。（
verses.textEnNiv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched—this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.
verses.textEnEsv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we looked upon and have touched with our hands, concerning the word of life—
verses.textEnNkjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, concerning the Word of life—
verses.textEnNlt: We proclaim to you the one who existed from the beginning, whom we have heard and seen. We saw him with our own eyes and touched him with our own hands. He is the Word of life.
verses.textEnNasb: What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we have looked at and touched with our hands, concerning the Word of Life—
verses.textEn: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched—this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.

verses.textZh: 这生命已经显现出来，我们见过了，现在也作见证，并且向你们宣扬这本来与父同在，又向我们显现过的永远的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这生命已经显现出来，我们见过了，现在也作见证，并且向你们宣扬这本来与父同在，又向我们显现过的永远的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 这生命已经显现出来，我们也看见过，现在又作见证，将原与父同在、且显现与我们那永远的生命传给你们。）
verses.textEnNiv: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.
verses.textEnEsv: the life was made manifest, and we have seen it, and testify to it and proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was made manifest to us—
verses.textEnNkjv: the life was manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and declare to you that eternal life which was with the Father and was manifested to us—
verses.textEnNlt: This one who is life itself was revealed to us, and we have seen him. And now we testify and proclaim to you that he is the one who is eternal life. He was with the Father, and then he was revealed to us.
verses.textEnNasb: and the life was revealed, and we have seen and testify and proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was revealed to us—
verses.textEn: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.

verses.textZh: 我们把所看见所听见的向你们宣扬，使你们也可以和我们彼此相通。我们是与父和他的儿子耶稣基督彼此相通的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们把所看见所听见的向你们宣扬，使你们也可以和我们彼此相通。我们是与父和他的儿子耶稣基督彼此相通的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们将所看见、所听见的传给你们，使你们与我们相交。我们乃是与父并他儿子耶稣基督相交的。
verses.textEnNiv: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: that which we have seen and heard we proclaim also to you, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us; and truly our fellowship is with the Father and with His Son Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: We proclaim to you what we ourselves have actually seen and heard so that you may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: what we have seen and heard we proclaim to you also, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father, and with His Son Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 我们写这些事，是要使我们的喜乐充足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们写这些事，是要使我们的喜乐充足。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们将这些话写给你们，使你们 的喜乐充足。
verses.textEnNiv: We write this to make our joy complete.
verses.textEnEsv: And we are writing these things so that our joy may be complete.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these things we write to you that your joy may be full.
verses.textEnNlt: We are writing these things so that you may fully share our joy.
verses.textEnNasb: These things we write, so that our joy may be made complete.
verses.textEn: We write this to make our joy complete.

verses.textZh: 神是光，在他里面毫无黑暗；这就是我们从他那里听见，现在传给你们的信息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神是光，在他里面毫无黑暗；这就是我们从他那里听见，现在传给你们的信息。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就是光，在他毫无黑暗。这是我们从主所听见、又报给你们的信息。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the message we have heard from him and proclaim to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the message which we have heard from Him and declare to you, that God is light and in Him is no darkness at all.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message we heard from Jesus and now declare to you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you, that God is Light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
verses.textEn: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

verses.textZh: 我们若说自己与他彼此相通，却行在黑暗里，就是说谎话，不实行真理了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若说自己与他彼此相通，却行在黑暗里，就是说谎话，不实行真理了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若说是与神相交，却仍在黑暗里行，就是说谎话，不行真理了。
verses.textEnNiv: If we claim to have fellowship with him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live out the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: If we say we have fellowship with him while we walk in darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we say that we have fellowship with Him, and walk in darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: So we are lying if we say we have fellowship with God but go on living in spiritual darkness; we are not practicing the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: If we say that we have fellowship with Him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth;
verses.textEn: If we claim to have fellowship with him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live out the truth.

verses.textZh: 我们若行在光中，像他在光中一样，就彼此相通，他儿子耶稣的血也洁净我们脱离一切罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若行在光中，像他在光中一样，就彼此相通，他儿子耶稣的血也洁净我们脱离一切罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若在光明中行，如同神在光明中，就彼此相交，他儿子耶稣的血也洗净我们一切的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.
verses.textEnEsv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanses us from all sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But if we are living in the light, as God is in the light, then we have fellowship with each other, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
verses.textEnNasb: but if we walk in the Light as He Himself is in the Light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
verses.textEn: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

verses.textZh: 我们若说自己没有罪，就是自欺，真理就不在我们里面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若说自己没有罪，就是自欺，真理就不在我们里面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若说自己无罪，便是自欺，真理不在我们心里了。
verses.textEnNiv: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.
verses.textEnEsv: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.textEnNlt: If we claim we have no sin, we are only fooling ourselves and not living in the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: If we say that we have no sin, we are deceiving ourselves and the truth is not in us.
verses.textEn: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

verses.textZh: 我们若承认自己的罪，神是信实的、公义的，必定赦免我们的罪，洁净我们脱离一切不义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若承认自己的罪，神是信实的、公义的，必定赦免我们的罪，洁净我们脱离一切不义。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若认自己的罪，神是信实的，是公义的，必要赦免我们的罪，洗净我们一切的不义。
verses.textEnNiv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: But if we confess our sins to him, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and righteous, so that He will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.textEn: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

verses.textZh: 我们若说自己没有犯过罪，就是把神当作说谎的，他的道就不在我们心里了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若说自己没有犯过罪，就是把神当作说谎的，他的道就不在我们心里了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若说自己没有犯过罪，便是以神为说谎的，他的道也不在我们心里了。
verses.textEnNiv: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.
verses.textEnEsv: If we say we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make Him a liar, and His word is not in us.
verses.textEnNlt: If we claim we have not sinned, we are calling God a liar and showing that his word has no place in our hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: If we say that we have not sinned, we make Him a liar and His word is not in us.
verses.textEn: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.

verses.textZh: 我的孩子们，我写这些给你们，是要你们不犯罪。如果有人犯了罪，在父的面前我们有一位维护者，就是那义者耶稣基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的孩子们，我写这些给你们，是要你们不犯罪。如果有人犯了罪，在父的面前我们有一位维护者，就是那义者耶稣基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 我小子们哪，我将这些话写给你们，是要叫你们不犯罪。若有人犯罪，在父那里我们有一位中保，就是那义者耶稣基督。
verses.textEnNiv: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have an advocate with the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
verses.textEnEsv: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: My little children, these things I write to you, so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: My dear children, I am writing this to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate who pleads our case before the Father. He is Jesus Christ, the one who is truly righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous;
verses.textEn: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have an advocate with the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

verses.textZh: 他为我们的罪作了赎罪祭，不仅为我们的罪，也为全人类的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为我们的罪作了赎罪祭，不仅为我们的罪，也为全人类的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为我们的罪作了挽回祭，不是单为我们的罪，也是为普天下人的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.textEnEsv: He is the propitiation for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He Himself is the propitiation for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the whole world.
verses.textEnNlt: He himself is the sacrifice that atones for our sins—and not only our sins but the sins of all the world.
verses.textEnNasb: and He Himself is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.textEn: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

verses.textZh: 我们若遵守神的命令，这样，就知道我们已经认识他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若遵守神的命令，这样，就知道我们已经认识他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若遵守他的诫命，就晓得是认识他。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that we have come to know him if we keep his commands.
verses.textEnEsv: And by this we know that we have come to know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now by this we know that we know Him, if we keep His commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: And we can be sure that we know him if we obey his commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: By this we know that we have come to know Him, if we keep His commandments.
verses.textEn: We know that we have come to know him if we keep his commands.

verses.textZh: 凡是说"我已经认识他"，却不遵守他命令的，就是说谎的人，真理就不在他里面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是说"我已经认识他"，却不遵守他命令的，就是说谎的人，真理就不在他里面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若说「我认识他」，却不遵守他的诫命，便是说谎话的，真理也不在他心里了。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever says, "I know him," but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever says "I know him" but does not keep his commandments is a liar, and the truth is not in him,
verses.textEnNkjv: He who says, "I know Him," and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone claims, "I know God," but doesn’t obey God’s commandments, that person is a liar and is not living in the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who says, "I have come to know Him," and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
verses.textEn: Whoever says, "I know him," but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.

verses.textZh: 然而凡是遵守他的道的，他爱神的心就的确在他里面完全了。这样，我们就知道我们是在神里面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而凡是遵守他的道的，他爱神的心就的确在他里面完全了。这样，我们就知道我们是在神里面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡遵守主道的，爱神的心在他里面实在是完全的。从此，我们知道我们是在主里面。
verses.textEnNiv: But if anyone obeys his word, love for God is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him:
verses.textEnEsv: but whoever keeps his word, in him truly the love of God is perfected. By this we may know that we are in him:
verses.textEnNkjv: But whoever keeps His word, truly the love of God is perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who obey God’s word truly show how completely they love him. That is how we know we are living in him.
verses.textEnNasb: but whoever follows His word, in him the love of God has truly been perfected. By this we know that we are in Him:
verses.textEn: But if anyone obeys his word, love for God is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him:

verses.textZh: 凡说自己是住在他里面的，就应该照着他所行的去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡说自己是住在他里面的，就应该照着他所行的去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若说他住在主里面，就该自己照主所行的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus did.
verses.textEnEsv: whoever says he abides in him ought to walk in the same way in which he walked.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk just as He walked.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who say they live in God should live their lives as Jesus did.
verses.textEnNasb: the one who says that he remains in Him ought, himself also, to walk just as He walked.
verses.textEn: Whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus did.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，我写给你们的，不是一条新命令，而是你们本来就有的旧命令。这旧命令就是你们听过的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，我写给你们的，不是一条新命令，而是你们本来就有的旧命令。这旧命令就是你们听过的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我写给你们的，不是一条新命令，乃是你们从起初所受的旧命令；这旧命令就是你们所听见的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, I am writing you no new commandment, but an old commandment that you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word that you have heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you have had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, I am not writing a new commandment for you; rather it is an old one you have had from the very beginning. This old commandment—to love one another—is the same message you heard before.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, I am not writing a new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you have had from the beginning; the old commandment is the word which you have heard.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.

verses.textZh: 然而，因为黑暗渐渐消逝，真光已在照耀，我写给你们的也是一条新命令，这在神和在你们来说，都是真的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，因为黑暗渐渐消逝，真光已在照耀，我写给你们的也是一条新命令，这在神和在你们来说，都是真的。
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，我写给你们的，是一条新命令，在主是真的，在你们也是真的；因为黑暗渐渐过去，真光已经照耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.
verses.textEnEsv: At the same time, it is a new commandment that I am writing to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, a new commandment I write to you, which thing is true in Him and in you, because the darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet it is also new. Jesus lived the truth of this commandment, and you also are living it. For the darkness is disappearing, and the true light is already shining.
verses.textEnNasb: On the other hand, I am writing a new commandment to you, which is true in Him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true Light is already shining.
verses.textEn: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.

verses.textZh: 凡是说自己在光明中，却恨他的弟兄的，他到现在还在黑暗里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是说自己在光明中，却恨他的弟兄的，他到现在还在黑暗里。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若说自己在光明中，却恨他的弟兄，他到如今还是在黑暗里。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever says he is in the light and hates his brother is still in darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness until now.
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone claims, "I am living in the light," but hates a fellow believer, that person is still living in darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who says that he is in the Light and yet hates his brother or sister is in the darkness until now.
verses.textEn: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.

verses.textZh: 凡是爱弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在光明中他就不会跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是爱弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在光明中他就不会跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他并没有绊跌的缘由。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever loves his brother abides in the light, and in him there is no cause for stumbling.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who loves his brother abides in the light, and there is no cause for stumbling in him.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who loves a fellow believer is living in the light and does not cause others to stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who loves his brother and sister remains in the Light, and there is nothing in him to cause stumbling.
verses.textEn: Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.

verses.textZh: 凡是恨弟兄的，就是在黑暗里，也在黑暗里行事。他不知道往哪里去，因为黑暗弄瞎了他的眼睛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是恨弟兄的，就是在黑暗里，也在黑暗里行事。他不知道往哪里去，因为黑暗弄瞎了他的眼睛。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独恨弟兄的，是在黑暗里，且在黑暗里行，也不知道往哪里去，因为黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
verses.textEnNiv: But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness. They do not know where they are going, because the darkness has blinded them.
verses.textEnEsv: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who hates his brother is in darkness and walks in darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: But anyone who hates a fellow believer is still living and walking in darkness. Such a person does not know the way to go, having been blinded by the darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who hates his brother or sister is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.textEn: But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness. They do not know where they are going, because the darkness has blinded them.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，我写信给你们， 因为你们的罪因着主的名已经得到赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，我写信给你们， 因为你们的罪因着主的名已经得到赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，我写信给你们， 因为你们的罪藉着主名得了赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.
verses.textEnEsv: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven for his name’s sake.
verses.textEnNkjv: I write to you, little children, Because your sins are forgiven you for His name’s sake.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to you who are God’s children because your sins have been forgiven through Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven you on account of His name.
verses.textEn: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.

verses.textZh: 父老们，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识太初就存在的那一位。 青年们，我写信给你们， 因为你们已经胜过那恶者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 父老们，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识太初就存在的那一位。 青年们，我写信给你们， 因为你们已经胜过那恶者。
verses.textZhCuv: 父老啊，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识那从起初原有的。 少年人哪，我写信给你们， 因为你们胜了那恶者。
verses.textEnNiv: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.
verses.textEnEsv: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, children, because you know the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: I write to you, fathers, Because you have known Him whois from the beginning. I write to you, young men, Because you have overcome the wicked one. I write to you, little children, Because you have known the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to you who are mature in the faith because you know Christ, who existed from the beginning. I am writing to you who are young in the faith because you have won your battle with the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who has been from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
verses.textEn: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识父。 父老们，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识太初就存在的那一位。 青年们，我写信给你们， 因为你们强壮，神的道在你们心里， 你们也胜过了那恶者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识父。 父老们，我写信给你们， 因为你们认识太初就存在的那一位。 青年们，我写信给你们， 因为你们强壮，神的道在你们心里， 你们也胜过了那恶者。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，我曾写信给你们， 因为你们认识父。 父老啊，我曾写信给你们， 因为你们认识那从起初原有的。 少年人哪，我曾写信给你们； 因为你们刚强，神的道常存在你们心里； 你们也胜了那恶者。
verses.textEnNiv: I write to you, dear children, because you know the Father. I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God lives in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.textEnEsv: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have written to you, fathers, Because you have known Him whois from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, Because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, And you have overcome the wicked one.
verses.textEnNlt: I have written to you who are God’s children because you know the Father. I have written to you who are mature in the faith because you know Christ, who existed from the beginning. I have written to you who are young in the faith because you are strong. God’s word lives in your hearts, and you have won your battle with the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who has been from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
verses.textEn: I write to you, dear children, because you know the Father. I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God lives in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

verses.textZh: 不要爱世界和世上的东西。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要爱世界和世上的东西。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要爱世界和世界上的事。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not love this world nor the things it offers you, for when you love the world, you do not have the love of the Father in you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.textEn: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.

verses.textZh: 原来世上的一切，就如肉体的私欲，眼目的私欲和今生的骄傲，都不是出于父，而是从世界来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来世上的一切，就如肉体的私欲，眼目的私欲和今生的骄傲，都不是出于父，而是从世界来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，凡世界上的事，就像肉体的情欲、眼目的情欲，并今生的骄傲，都不是从父来的，乃是从世界来的。
verses.textEnNiv: For everything in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—comes not from the Father but from the world.
verses.textEnEsv: For all that is in the world— the desires of the flesh and the desires of the eyes and pride of life —is not from the Father but is from the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not of the Father but is of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: For the world offers only a craving for physical pleasure, a craving for everything we see, and pride in our achievements and possessions. These are not from the Father, but are from this world.
verses.textEnNasb: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the boastful pride of life, is not from the Father, but is from the world.
verses.textEn: For everything in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—comes not from the Father but from the world.

verses.textZh: 这世界和世上的私欲都要渐渐过去，但那遵行神旨意的却存到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这世界和世上的私欲都要渐渐过去，但那遵行神旨意的却存到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 这世界和其上的情欲都要过去，惟独遵行神旨意的，是永远常存。
verses.textEnNiv: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.
verses.textEnEsv: And the world is passing away along with its desires, but whoever does the will of God abides forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the world is passing away, and the lust of it; but he who does the will of God abides forever.
verses.textEnNlt: And this world is fading away, along with everything that people crave. But anyone who does what pleases God will live forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The world is passing away and also its lusts; but the one who does the will of God continues to live forever.
verses.textEn: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，现在是末世的时候了。你们听过敌基督者要来，现在已经有不少敌基督起来了；因此我们就知道这是末世的时候了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，现在是末世的时候了。你们听过敌基督者要来，现在已经有不少敌基督起来了；因此我们就知道这是末世的时候了。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，如今是末时了。你们曾听见说，那敌基督的要来；现在已经有好些敌基督的出来了，从此我们就知道如今是末时了。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.
verses.textEnEsv: Children, it is the last hour, and as you have heard that antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have come. Therefore we know that it is the last hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: Little children, it is the last hour; and as you have heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come, by which we know that it is the last hour.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear children, the last hour is here. You have heard that the Antichrist is coming, and already many such antichrists have appeared. From this we know that the last hour has come.
verses.textEnNasb: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you heard that antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have appeared; from this we know that it is the last hour.
verses.textEn: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.

verses.textZh: 他们从我们中间离去，这就表明他们是不属于我们的。其实他们并不属于我们，如果真的属于我们，就一定会留在我们中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从我们中间离去，这就表明他们是不属于我们的。其实他们并不属于我们，如果真的属于我们，就一定会留在我们中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从我们中间出去，却不是属我们的；若是属我们的，就必仍旧与我们同在；他们出去，显明都不是属我们的。
verses.textEnNiv: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.
verses.textEnEsv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us. But they went out, that it might become plain that they all are not of us.
verses.textEnNkjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us; but theywentout that they might be made manifest, that none of them were of us.
verses.textEnNlt: These people left our churches, but they never really belonged with us; otherwise they would have stayed with us. When they left, it proved that they did not belong with us.
verses.textEnNasb: They went out from us, but they were not really of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us; but they went out, so that it would be evident that they all are not of us.
verses.textEn: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.

verses.textZh: 你们从那圣者得着膏抹，这是你们都知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们从那圣者得着膏抹，这是你们都知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从那圣者受了恩膏，并且知道这一切的事 。
verses.textEnNiv: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: But you have been anointed by the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are not like that, for the Holy One has given you his Spirit, and all of you know the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all know.
verses.textEn: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

verses.textZh: 我写信给你们，不是因为你们不明白真理，而是因为你们明白，又因为谎言绝不会出于真理的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我写信给你们，不是因为你们不明白真理，而是因为你们明白，又因为谎言绝不会出于真理的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我写信给你们，不是因你们不知道真理，正是因你们知道，并且知道没有虚谎是从真理出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: I write to you, not because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: So I am writing to you not because you don’t know the truth but because you know the difference between truth and lies.
verses.textEnNasb: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.textEn: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.

verses.textZh: 那么，谁是说谎的呢？不就是那否认耶稣是基督的吗？否认父和子的，他就是敌基督的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，谁是说谎的呢？不就是那否认耶稣是基督的吗？否认父和子的，他就是敌基督的。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁是说谎话的呢？不是那不认耶稣为基督的吗？不认父与子的，这就是敌基督的。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is the liar? It is whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a person is the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is a liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist who denies the Father and the Son.
verses.textEnNlt: And who is a liar? Anyone who says that Jesus is not the Christ. Anyone who denies the Father and the Son is an antichrist.
verses.textEnNasb: Who is the liar except the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, the one who denies the Father and the Son.
verses.textEn: Who is the liar? It is whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a person is the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.

verses.textZh: 凡否认子的，就没有父；承认子的，连父也有了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡否认子的，就没有父；承认子的，连父也有了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不认子的，就没有父；认子的，连父也有了。
verses.textEnNiv: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.
verses.textEnEsv: No one who denies the Son has the Father. Whoever confesses the Son has the Father also.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father either; he who acknowledges the Son has the Father also.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who denies the Son doesn’t have the Father, either. But anyone who acknowledges the Son has the Father also.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father; the one who confesses the Son has the Father also.
verses.textEn: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

verses.textZh: 至于你们，总要把起初所听见的存记在你们心里；你们若把起初所听见的存记在心里，你们也就住在子和父里面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你们，总要把起初所听见的存记在你们心里；你们若把起初所听见的存记在心里，你们也就住在子和父里面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到你们，务要将那从起初所听见的，常存在心里。若将从起初所听见的存在心里，你们就必住在子里面，也必住在父里面。
verses.textEnNiv: As for you, see that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.
verses.textEnEsv: Let what you heard from the beginning abide in you. If what you heard from the beginning abides in you, then you too will abide in the Son and in the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let that abide in you which you heard from the beginning. If what you heard from the beginning abides in you, you also will abide in the Son and in the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: So you must remain faithful to what you have been taught from the beginning. If you do, you will remain in fellowship with the Son and with the Father.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, see that what you heard from the beginning remains in you. If what you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.
verses.textEn: As for you, see that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

verses.textZh: 他应许给我们的，就是永远的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他应许给我们的，就是永远的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 主所应许我们的就是永生。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is what he promised us—eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the promise that he made to us — eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the promise that He has promised us—eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: And in this fellowship we enjoy the eternal life he promised us.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the promise which He Himself made to us: eternal life.
verses.textEn: And this is what he promised us—eternal life.

verses.textZh: 我把这些事写给你们，是指着那些欺骗你们的人说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把这些事写给你们，是指着那些欺骗你们的人说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将这些话写给你们，是指着那引诱你们的人说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.
verses.textEnEsv: I write these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things I have written to you concerning those who tryto deceive you.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing these things to warn you about those who want to lead you astray.
verses.textEnNasb: These things I have written to you concerning those who are trying to deceive you.
verses.textEn: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

verses.textZh: 你们既然在你们里面有从主领受的膏抹，就不需要别人教导你们了，因为在一切事上有主的膏抹教导你们；这膏抹是真的，不是假的，你们应该按着他所教导的住在他里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然在你们里面有从主领受的膏抹，就不需要别人教导你们了，因为在一切事上有主的膏抹教导你们；这膏抹是真的，不是假的，你们应该按着他所教导的住在他里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从主所受的恩膏常存在你们心里，并不用人教训你们，自有主的恩膏在凡事上教训你们。这恩膏是真的，不是假的；你们要按这恩膏的教训住在主里面。
verses.textEnNiv: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit—just as it has taught you, remain in him.
verses.textEnEsv: But the anointing that you received from him abides in you, and you have no need that anyone should teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about everything, and is true, and is no lie—just as it has taught you, abide in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the anointing which you have received from Him abides in you, and you do not need that anyone teach you; but as the same anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is not a lie, and just as it has taught you, you will abide in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But you have received the Holy Spirit, and he lives within you, so you don’t need anyone to teach you what is true. For the Spirit teaches you everything you need to know, and what he teaches is true—it is not a lie. So just as he has taught you, remain in fellowship with Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for you, the anointing which you received from Him remains in you, and you have no need for anyone to teach you; but as His anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie, and just as it has taught you, you remain in Him.
verses.textEn: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit—just as it has taught you, remain in him.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，你们要住在主里面。这样，他若显现，我们就可以坦然无惧；他来的时候，我们也不至惭愧地躲避他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，你们要住在主里面。这样，他若显现，我们就可以坦然无惧；他来的时候，我们也不至惭愧地躲避他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，你们要住在主里面。这样，他若显现，我们就可以坦然无惧；当他来的时候，在他面前也不至于惭愧。
verses.textEnNiv: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, little children, abide in him, so that when he appears we may have confidence and not shrink from him in shame at his coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, little children, abide in Him, that when He appears, we may have confidence and not be ashamed before Him at His coming.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, dear children, remain in fellowship with Christ so that when he returns, you will be full of courage and not shrink back from him in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, little children, remain in Him, so that when He appears, we may have confidence and not draw back from Him in shame at His coming.
verses.textEn: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.

verses.textZh: 你们既然晓得神是公义的，就应当知道所有行公义的都是从他生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然晓得神是公义的，就应当知道所有行公义的都是从他生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若知道他是公义的，就知道凡行公义之人都是他所生的。
verses.textEnNiv: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.
verses.textEnEsv: If you know that he is righteous, you may be sure that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you know that He is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness is born of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Since we know that Christ is righteous, we also know that all who do what is right are God’s children.
verses.textEnNasb: If you know that He is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness also has been born of Him.
verses.textEn: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.

verses.textZh: 你们看，父赐给我们的是怎样的爱，就是让我们可以称为神的儿女，我们也真是他的儿女。因此，世人不认识我们，是因为他们不认识父。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看，父赐给我们的是怎样的爱，就是让我们可以称为神的儿女，我们也真是他的儿女。因此，世人不认识我们，是因为他们不认识父。
verses.textZhCuv: 你看父赐给我们是何等的慈爱，使我们得称为神的儿女；我们也真是他的儿女。世人所以不认识我们，是因未曾认识他。
verses.textEnNiv: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
verses.textEnEsv: See what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God; and so we are. The reason why the world does not know us is that it did not know him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold what manner of love the Father has bestowed on us, that we should be called children of God! Therefore the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.
verses.textEnNlt: See how very much our Father loves us, for he calls us his children, and that is what we are! But the people who belong to this world don’t recognize that we are God’s children because they don’t know him.
verses.textEnNasb: See how great a love the Father has given us, that we would be called children of God; and in fact we are. For this reason the world does not know us: because it did not know Him.
verses.textEn: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，现在我们是神的儿女，将来怎样，还没有显明；然而我们知道：主若显现，我们必要像他，因为我们必要看见他本来是怎样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，现在我们是神的儿女，将来怎样，还没有显明；然而我们知道：主若显现，我们必要像他，因为我们必要看见他本来是怎样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我们现在是神的儿女，将来如何，还未显明；但我们知道，主若显现，我们必要像他，因为必得见他的真体。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, we are God’s children now, and what we will be has not yet appeared; but we know that when he appears we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he is.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, now we are children of God; and it has not yet been revealed what we shall be, but we know that when He is revealed, we shall be like Him, for we shall see Him as He is.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, we are already God’s children, but he has not yet shown us what we will be like when Christ appears. But we do know that we will be like him, for we will see him as he really is.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it has not appeared as yet what we will be. We know that when He appears, we will be like Him, because we will see Him just as He is.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

verses.textZh: 凡对他存着这盼望的，就洁净自己，像他一样的洁净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡对他存着这盼望的，就洁净自己，像他一样的洁净。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡向他有这指望的，就洁净自己，像他洁净一样。
verses.textEnNiv: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.
verses.textEnEsv: And everyone who thus hopes in him purifies himself as he is pure.
verses.textEnNkjv: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as He is pure.
verses.textEnNlt: And all who have this eager expectation will keep themselves pure, just as he is pure.
verses.textEnNasb: And everyone who has this hope set on Him purifies himself, just as He is pure.
verses.textEn: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.

verses.textZh: 凡是犯罪的，就是作了不法的事；罪就是不法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是犯罪的，就是作了不法的事；罪就是不法。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡犯罪的，就是违背律法；违背律法就是罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who makes a practice of sinning also practices lawlessness; sin is lawlessness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever commits sin also commits lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who sins is breaking God’s law, for all sin is contrary to the law of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
verses.textEn: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.

verses.textZh: 你们知道主曾经显现，为要除掉罪，他自己却没有罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道主曾经显现，为要除掉罪，他自己却没有罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们知道主曾显现，是要除掉人的罪，在他并没有罪。
verses.textEnNiv: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.
verses.textEnEsv: You know that he appeared in order to take away sins, and in him there is no sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you know that He was manifested to take away our sins, and in Him there is no sin.
verses.textEnNlt: And you know that Jesus came to take away our sins, and there is no sin in him.
verses.textEnNasb: You know that He appeared in order to take away sins; and in Him there is no sin.
verses.textEn: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.

verses.textZh: 凡是住在他里面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾见过他，也不认识他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是住在他里面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾见过他，也不认识他。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡住在他里面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看见他，也未曾认识他。
verses.textEnNiv: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.
verses.textEnEsv: No one who abides in him keeps on sinning; no one who keeps on sinning has either seen him or known him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever abides in Him does not sin. Whoever sins has neither seen Him nor known Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who continues to live in him will not sin. But anyone who keeps on sinning does not know him or understand who he is.
verses.textEnNasb: No one who remains in Him sins continually; no one who sins continually has seen Him or knows Him.
verses.textEn: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，不要受人欺骗，行义的才是义人，正如主是公义的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，不要受人欺骗，行义的才是义人，正如主是公义的。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，不要被人诱惑。行义的才是义人，正如主是义的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: Little children, let no one deceive you. Whoever practices righteousness is righteous, as he is righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Little children, let no one deceive you. He who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear children, don’t let anyone deceive you about this: When people do what is right, it shows that they are righteous, even as Christ is righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: Little children, make sure no one deceives you; the one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous;
verses.textEn: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

verses.textZh: 犯罪的是出于魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。因此，神的儿子显现了，是要除灭魔鬼的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犯罪的是出于魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。因此，神的儿子显现了，是要除灭魔鬼的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever makes a practice of sinning is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the works of the devil.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has sinned from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that He might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.textEnNlt: But when people keep on sinning, it shows that they belong to the devil, who has been sinning since the beginning. But the Son of God came to destroy the works of the devil.
verses.textEnNasb: the one who practices sin is of the devil; for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God appeared for this purpose, to destroy the works of the devil.
verses.textEn: The one who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work.

verses.textZh: 凡是从神生的，就不犯罪，因为神的生命 在他里面；他也不能犯罪，因为他是从神生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是从神生的，就不犯罪，因为神的生命 在他里面；他也不能犯罪，因为他是从神生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从神生的，就不犯罪，因神的道 存在他心里；他也不能犯罪，因为他是由神生的。
verses.textEnNiv: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot go on sinning, because they have been born of God.
verses.textEnEsv: No one born of God makes a practice of sinning, for God’s seed abides in him; and he cannot keep on sinning, because he has been born of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever has been born of God does not sin, for His seed remains in him; and he cannot sin, because he has been born of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who have been born into God’s family do not make a practice of sinning, because God’s life is in them. So they can’t keep on sinning, because they are children of God.
verses.textEnNasb: No one who has been born of God practices sin, because His seed remains in him; and he cannot sin continually, because he has been born of God.
verses.textEn: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot go on sinning, because they have been born of God.

verses.textZh: 这样，谁是神的儿女，谁是魔鬼的儿女，就很明显了。凡不行义的，就不是出于神，不爱弟兄的，也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，谁是神的儿女，谁是魔鬼的儿女，就很明显了。凡不行义的，就不是出于神，不爱弟兄的，也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此就显出谁是神的儿女，谁是魔鬼的儿女。凡不行义的就不属神，不爱弟兄的也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not God’s child, nor is anyone who does not love their brother and sister.
verses.textEnEsv: By this it is evident who are the children of God, and who are the children of the devil: whoever does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is the one who does not love his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: In this the children of God and the children of the devil are manifest: Whoever does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is he who does not love his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: So now we can tell who are children of God and who are children of the devil. Anyone who does not live righteously and does not love other believers does not belong to God.
verses.textEnNasb: By this the children of God and the children of the devil are obvious: anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor the one who does not love his brother and sister.
verses.textEn: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not God’s child, nor is anyone who does not love their brother and sister.

verses.textZh: 我们应当彼此相爱，因为这是你们从起初听见的信息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们应当彼此相爱，因为这是你们从起初听见的信息。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们应当彼此相爱。这就是你们从起初所听见的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is the message which you have heard from the beginning, that we are to love one another;
verses.textEn: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

verses.textZh: 不要像该隐，他是属于那恶者的，他又杀了自己的弟弟。为甚么杀他呢？因为他自己的行为是恶的，弟弟的行为是义的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要像该隐，他是属于那恶者的，他又杀了自己的弟弟。为甚么杀他呢？因为他自己的行为是恶的，弟弟的行为是义的。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可像该隐；他是属那恶者，杀了他的兄弟。为什么杀了他呢？因自己的行为是恶的，兄弟的行为是善的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother’s were righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: We should not be like Cain, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own deeds were evil and his brother’s righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: not as Cain who was of the wicked one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his works were evil and his brother’s righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: We must not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? Because Cain had been doing what was evil, and his brother had been doing what was righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: not as Cain, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother. And for what reason did he murder him? Because his own deeds were evil, but his brother’s were righteous.
verses.textEn: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother’s were righteous.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，世人若恨你们，不要希奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，世人若恨你们，不要希奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，世人若恨你们，不要以为希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be surprised, brothers, that the world hates you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not marvel, my brethren, if the world hates you.
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t be surprised, dear brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be surprised, brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
verses.textEn: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

verses.textZh: 我们因为爱弟兄，就知道我们已经出死入生了；不爱弟兄的，仍然住在死中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们因为爱弟兄，就知道我们已经出死入生了；不爱弟兄的，仍然住在死中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们因为爱弟兄，就晓得是已经出死入生了。没有爱心的，仍住在死中。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.
verses.textEnEsv: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. Whoever does not love abides in death.
verses.textEnNkjv: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brethren. He who does not love his brother abides in death.
verses.textEnNlt: If we love our brothers and sisters who are believers, it proves that we have passed from death to life. But a person who has no love is still dead.
verses.textEnNasb: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers and sisters. The one who does not love remains in death.
verses.textEn: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.

verses.textZh: 凡恨弟兄的，就是杀人的。你们知道，杀人的在他里面没有永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡恨弟兄的，就是杀人的。你们知道，杀人的在他里面没有永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡恨他弟兄的，就是杀人的；你们晓得凡杀人的，没有永生存在他里面。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who hates another brother or sister is really a murderer at heart. And you know that murderers don’t have eternal life within them.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who hates his brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
verses.textEn: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.

verses.textZh: 主为我们舍命，这样，我们就知道甚么是爱；我们也应当为弟兄舍命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主为我们舍命，这样，我们就知道甚么是爱；我们也应当为弟兄舍命。
verses.textZhCuv: 主为我们舍命，我们从此就知道何为爱；我们也当为弟兄舍命。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: By this we know love, that he laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: By this we know love, because He laid down His life for us. And we also ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: We know what real love is because Jesus gave up his life for us. So we also ought to give up our lives for our brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: We know love by this, that He laid down His life for us; and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEn: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 凡有世上财物的，看见弟兄穷乏，却硬着心肠不理，他怎能说他心里有神的爱呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有世上财物的，看见弟兄穷乏，却硬着心肠不理，他怎能说他心里有神的爱呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有世上财物的，看见弟兄穷乏，却塞住怜恤的心，爱神的心怎能存在他里面呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but has no pity on them, how can the love of God be in that person?
verses.textEnEsv: But if anyone has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, yet closes his heart against him, how does God’s love abide in him?
verses.textEnNkjv: But whoever has this world’s goods, and sees his brother in need, and shuts up his heart from him, how does the love of God abide in him?
verses.textEnNlt: If someone has enough money to live well and sees a brother or sister in need but shows no compassion—how can God’s love be in that person?
verses.textEnNasb: But whoever has worldly goods and sees his brother or sister in need, and closes his heart against him, how does the love of God remain in him?
verses.textEn: If anyone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but has no pity on them, how can the love of God be in that person?

verses.textZh: 孩子们，我们爱人，不要只在言语和舌头上，总要在行动和真诚上表现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，我们爱人，不要只在言语和舌头上，总要在行动和真诚上表现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，我们相爱，不要只在言语和舌头上，总要在行为和诚实上。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.
verses.textEnEsv: Little children, let us not love in word or talk but in deed and in truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: My little children, let us not love in word or in tongue, but in deed and in truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear children, let’s not merely say that we love each other; let us show the truth by our actions.
verses.textEnNasb: Little children, let’s not love with word or with tongue, but in deed and truth.
verses.textEn: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，我们的心若不责备我们，在神面前我们就可以坦然无惧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，我们的心若不责备我们，在神面前我们就可以坦然无惧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此就知道我们是属真理的，并且我们的心在神面前可以安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:
verses.textEnEsv: By this we shall know that we are of the truth and reassure our heart before him;
verses.textEnNkjv: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Our actions will show that we belong to the truth, so we will be confident when we stand before God.
verses.textEnNasb: We will know by this that we are of the truth, and will set our heart at ease before Him,
verses.textEn: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:

verses.textZh: 凡我们所求的，就必从他得着，因为我们遵守他的命令，作他所喜悦的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡我们所求的，就必从他得着，因为我们遵守他的命令，作他所喜悦的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的心若责备我们，神比我们的心大，一切事没有不知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.
verses.textEnEsv: for whenever our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and he knows everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if we feel guilty, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
verses.textEnNasb: that if our heart condemns us, that God is greater than our heart, and He knows all things.
verses.textEn: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.

verses.textZh: 神的命令，就是要我们信他的儿子耶稣基督的名，并且照着他的吩咐彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的命令，就是要我们信他的儿子耶稣基督的名，并且照着他的吩咐彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我们的心若不责备我们，就可以向神坦然无惧了。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence before God;
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence toward God.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, if we don’t feel guilty, we can come to God with bold confidence.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence before God;
verses.textEn: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God

verses.textZh: 凡是遵守神命令的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。凭着神所赐给我们的圣灵，我们就可以知道神住在我们里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是遵守神命令的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。凭着神所赐给我们的圣灵，我们就可以知道神住在我们里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我们一切所求的，就从他得着；因为我们遵守他的命令，行他所喜悦的事。
verses.textEnNiv: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.
verses.textEnEsv: and whatever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do what pleases him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever we ask we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do those things that are pleasing in His sight.
verses.textEnNlt: And we will receive from him whatever we ask because we obey him and do the things that please him.
verses.textEnNasb: and whatever we ask, we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do the things that are pleasing in His sight.
verses.textEn: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.

verses.textZh: 神的命令就是叫我们信他儿子耶稣基督的名，且照他所赐给我们的命令彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的命令就是叫我们信他儿子耶稣基督的名，且照他所赐给我们的命令彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的命令就是叫我们信他儿子耶稣基督的名，且照他所赐给我们的命令彼此相爱。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is his commandment, that we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as he has commanded us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is His commandment: that we should believe on the name of His Son Jesus Christ and love one another, as He gave us commandment.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is his commandment: We must believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.
verses.textEnNasb: This is His commandment, that we believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as He commanded us.
verses.textEn: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.

verses.textZh: 遵守神命令的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。我们所以知道神住在我们里面是因他所赐给我们的圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遵守神命令的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。我们所以知道神住在我们里面是因他所赐给我们的圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 遵守神命令的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。我们所以知道神住在我们里面是因他所赐给我们的圣灵。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who keeps God’s commands lives in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever keeps his commandments abides in God, and God in him. And by this we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit whom he has given us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he who keeps His commandments abides in Him, and He in him. And by this we know that He abides in us, by the Spirit whom He has given us.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who obey God’s commandments remain in fellowship with him, and he with them. And we know he lives in us because the Spirit he gave us lives in us.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who keeps His commandments remains in Him, and He in him. We know by this that He remains in us, by the Spirit whom He has given us.
verses.textEn: The one who keeps God’s commands lives in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，不要每个灵都信，总要试验那些灵是否出于神，因为有许多假先知已经来到世上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，不要每个灵都信，总要试验那些灵是否出于神，因为有许多假先知已经来到世上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，一切的灵，你们不可都信，总要试验那些灵是出于神的不是，因为世上有许多假先知已经出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, for many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, do not believe everyone who claims to speak by the Spirit. You must test them to see if the spirit they have comes from God. For there are many false prophets in the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.textZh: 你们可以这样认出神的灵：凡是承认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，那灵就是出于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们可以这样认出神的灵：凡是承认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，那灵就是出于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡灵认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，就是出于神的；从此你们可以认出神的灵来。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
verses.textEnEsv: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
verses.textEnNkjv: By this you know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
verses.textEnNlt: This is how we know if they have the Spirit of God: If a person claiming to be a prophet acknowledges that Jesus Christ came in a real body, that person has the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnNasb: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God;
verses.textEn: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

verses.textZh: 凡是不承认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，那灵就不是出于神，而是敌基督者的灵；你们听过他要来，现在他已经在世上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是不承认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的，那灵就不是出于神，而是敌基督者的灵；你们听过他要来，现在他已经在世上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡灵不认耶稣，就不是出于神，这是那敌基督者的灵。你们从前听见他要来，现在已经在世上了。
verses.textEnNiv: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.
verses.textEnEsv: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you heard was coming and now is in the world already.
verses.textEnNkjv: and every spirit that does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God. And this is the spirit of the Antichrist, which you have heard was coming, and is now already in the world.
verses.textEnNlt: But if someone claims to be a prophet and does not acknowledge the truth about Jesus, that person is not from God. Such a person has the spirit of the Antichrist, which you heard is coming into the world and indeed is already here.
verses.textEnNasb: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God; this is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming, and now it is already in the world.
verses.textEn: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，你们是属于神的，并且已经胜过他们，因为那在你们里面的比那在世上的更大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，你们是属于神的，并且已经胜过他们，因为那在你们里面的比那在世上的更大。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，你们是属神的，并且胜了他们；因为那在你们里面的，比那在世界上的更大。
verses.textEnNiv: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
verses.textEnEsv: Little children, you are from God and have overcome them, for he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.
verses.textEnNlt: But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world.
verses.textEnNasb: You are from God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
verses.textEn: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

verses.textZh: 他们是属于世界的，因此讲论属世的事，世界也就听从他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是属于世界的，因此讲论属世的事，世界也就听从他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们是属世界的，所以论世界的事，世人也听从他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.
verses.textEnEsv: They are from the world; therefore they speak from the world, and the world listens to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are of the world. Therefore they speak as of the world, and the world hears them.
verses.textEnNlt: Those people belong to this world, so they speak from the world’s viewpoint, and the world listens to them.
verses.textEnNasb: They are from the world, therefore they speak as from the world, and the world listens to them.
verses.textEn: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.

verses.textZh: 我们是属于神的，认识神的就听从我们，不属于神的就不听从我们。这样，我们就可以辨别真理的灵和谬妄的灵了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们是属于神的，认识神的就听从我们，不属于神的就不听从我们。这样，我们就可以辨别真理的灵和谬妄的灵了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们是属神的，认识神的就听从我们；不属神的就不听从我们。从此我们可以认出真理的灵和谬妄的灵来。
verses.textEnNiv: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.
verses.textEnEsv: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. By this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
verses.textEnNkjv: We are of God. He who knows God hears us; he who is not of God does not hear us. By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
verses.textEnNlt: But we belong to God, and those who know God listen to us. If they do not belong to God, they do not listen to us. That is how we know if someone has the Spirit of truth or the spirit of deception.
verses.textEnNasb: We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us; the one who is not from God does not listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
verses.textEn: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，我们应当彼此相爱，因为爱是从神那里来的。凡是爱人的，都是从神生的，并且认识神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，我们应当彼此相爱，因为爱是从神那里来的。凡是爱人的，都是从神生的，并且认识神。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我们应当彼此相爱，因为爱是从神来的。凡有爱心的，都是由神而生，并且认识神。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God, and whoever loves has been born of God and knows God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, let us continue to love one another, for love comes from God. Anyone who loves is a child of God and knows God.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, let’s love one another; for love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

verses.textZh: 不爱人的，就不认识神，因为神就是爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不爱人的，就不认识神，因为神就是爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有爱心的，就不认识神，因为神就是爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who does not love does not know God, for God is love.
verses.textEnNlt: But anyone who does not love does not know God, for God is love.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
verses.textEn: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

verses.textZh: 神差遣他的独生子到世上来，要使我们借着他而活；神的爱就在我们中间显明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神差遣他的独生子到世上来，要使我们借着他而活；神的爱就在我们中间显明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神差他独生子到世间来，使我们藉着他得生，神爱我们的心在此就显明了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.
verses.textEnEsv: In this the love of God was made manifest among us, that God sent his only Son into the world, so that we might live through him.
verses.textEnNkjv: In this the love of God was manifested toward us, that God has sent His only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through Him.
verses.textEnNlt: God showed how much he loved us by sending his one and only Son into the world so that we might have eternal life through him.
verses.textEnNasb: By this the love of God was revealed in us, that God has sent His only Son into the world so that we may live through Him.
verses.textEn: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

verses.textZh: 不是我们爱神，而是神爱我们，差遣他的儿子为我们的罪作了赎罪祭，这就是爱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是我们爱神，而是神爱我们，差遣他的儿子为我们的罪作了赎罪祭，这就是爱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 不是我们爱神，乃是神爱我们，差他的儿子为我们的罪作了挽回祭，这就是爱了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.
verses.textEnEsv: In this is love, not that we have loved God but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son tobe the propitiation for our sins.
verses.textEnNlt: This is real love—not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as a sacrifice to take away our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.textEn: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的，神既然这样爱我们，我们也应当彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的，神既然这样爱我们，我们也应当彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，神既是这样爱我们，我们也当彼此相爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, since God loved us that much, we surely ought to love each other.
verses.textEnNasb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
verses.textEn: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

verses.textZh: 从来没有人见过神，我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，他的爱也在我们里面得到成全了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从来没有人见过神，我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，他的爱也在我们里面得到成全了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从来没有人见过神，我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，爱他的心在我们里面得以完全了。
verses.textEnNiv: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.
verses.textEnEsv: No one has ever seen God; if we love one another, God abides in us and his love is perfected in us.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God abides in us, and His love has been perfected in us.
verses.textEnNlt: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is brought to full expression in us.
verses.textEnNasb: No one has ever seen God; if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
verses.textEn: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

verses.textZh: 神把他的灵赐给我们，我们就知道我们是住在他里面，他也住在我们里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神把他的灵赐给我们，我们就知道我们是住在他里面，他也住在我们里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 神将他的灵赐给我们，从此就知道我们是住在他里面，他也住在我们里面。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: By this we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: By this we know that we abide in Him, and He in us, because He has given us of His Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: And God has given us his Spirit as proof that we live in him and he in us.
verses.textEnNasb: By this we know that we remain in Him and He in us, because He has given to us of His Spirit.
verses.textEn: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

verses.textZh: 父差遣子作世人的救主，这是我们见过的，并且现在作见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 父差遣子作世人的救主，这是我们见过的，并且现在作见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 父差子作世人的救主；这是我们所看见且作见证的。
verses.textEnNiv: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
verses.textEnEsv: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Furthermore, we have seen with our own eyes and now testify that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.
verses.textEn: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

verses.textZh: 凡承认耶稣是神的儿子的，神就住在他里面，他也住在神里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡承认耶稣是神的儿子的，神就住在他里面，他也住在神里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡认耶稣为神儿子的，神就住在他里面，他也住在神里面。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they in God.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
verses.textEnNlt: All who declare that Jesus is the Son of God have God living in them, and they live in God.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
verses.textEn: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they in God.

verses.textZh: 神对我们的爱，我们已经明白了，而且相信了。神就是爱；住在爱里面的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对我们的爱，我们已经明白了，而且相信了。神就是爱；住在爱里面的，就住在神里面，神也住在他里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 神爱我们的心，我们也知道也信。神就是爱；住在爱里面的，就是住在神里面，神也住在他里面。
verses.textEnNiv: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
verses.textEnEsv: So we have come to know and to believe the love that God has for us. God is love, and whoever abides in love abides in God, and God abides in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we have known and believed the love that God has for us. God is love, and he who abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
verses.textEnNlt: We know how much God loves us, and we have put our trust in his love. God is love, and all who live in love live in God, and God lives in them.
