verses.textEnNasb: We have come to know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and the one who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
verses.textEn: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.

verses.textZh: 这样，爱在我们里面就得到成全，使我们在审判的日子，可以坦然无惧。因为他怎样，我们在这世上也怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，爱在我们里面就得到成全，使我们在审判的日子，可以坦然无惧。因为他怎样，我们在这世上也怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，爱在我们里面得以完全，我们就可以在审判的日子坦然无惧。因为他如何，我们在这世上也如何。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: By this is love perfected with us, so that we may have confidence for the day of judgment, because as he is so also are we in this world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Love has been perfected among us in this: that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as He is, so are we in this world.
verses.textEnNlt: And as we live in God, our love grows more perfect. So we will not be afraid on the day of judgment, but we can face him with confidence because we live like Jesus here in this world.
verses.textEnNasb: By this, love is perfected with us, so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment; because as He is, we also are in this world.
verses.textEn: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.

verses.textZh: 爱里没有惧怕，完全的爱可以把惧怕驱除，因为惧怕含有刑罚，惧怕的人在爱里还没有完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱里没有惧怕，完全的爱可以把惧怕驱除，因为惧怕含有刑罚，惧怕的人在爱里还没有完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱里没有惧怕；爱既完全，就把惧怕除去。因为惧怕里含着刑罚，惧怕的人在爱里未得完全。
verses.textEnNiv: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.
verses.textEnEsv: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear. For fear has to do with punishment, and whoever fears has not been perfected in love.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear involves torment. But he who fears has not been made perfect in love.
verses.textEnNlt: Such love has no fear, because perfect love expels all fear. If we are afraid, it is for fear of punishment, and this shows that we have not fully experienced his perfect love.
verses.textEnNasb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment, and the one who fears is not perfected in love.
verses.textEn: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

verses.textZh: 我们爱，因为神先爱我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们爱，因为神先爱我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们爱，因为神先爱我们。
verses.textEnNiv: We love because he first loved us.
verses.textEnEsv: We love because he first loved us.
verses.textEnNkjv: We love Him because He first loved us.
verses.textEnNlt: We love each other because he loved us first.
verses.textEnNasb: We love, because He first loved us.
verses.textEn: We love because he first loved us.

verses.textZh: 人若说"我爱神"，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎的。不爱看得见的弟兄，就不能爱看不见的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若说"我爱神"，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎的。不爱看得见的弟兄，就不能爱看不见的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若说「我爱神」，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎话的；不爱他所看见的弟兄，就不能爱没有看见的神 。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: If someone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
verses.textEnNlt: If someone says, "I love God," but hates a fellow believer, that person is a liar; for if we don’t love people we can see, how can we love God, whom we cannot see?
verses.textEnNasb: If someone says, "I love God," and yet he hates his brother or sister, he is a liar; for the one who does not love his brother and sister whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
verses.textEn: Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.

verses.textZh: 爱神的，也应当爱弟兄，这就是我们从神领受的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱神的，也应当爱弟兄，这就是我们从神领受的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱神的，也当爱弟兄，这是我们从神所受的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.
verses.textEnEsv: And this commandment we have from him: whoever loves God must also love his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this commandment we have from Him: that he who loves God must love his brother also.
verses.textEnNlt: And he has given us this command: Those who love God must also love their fellow believers.
verses.textEnNasb: And this commandment we have from Him, that the one who loves God must also love his brother and sister.
verses.textEn: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.

verses.textZh: 凡信耶稣是基督的，都是从神生的，凡爱那生他的，也必爱那从他而生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡信耶稣是基督的，都是从神生的，凡爱那生他的，也必爱那从他而生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡信耶稣是基督的，都是从神而生，凡爱生他之神的，也必爱从神生的。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves whoever has been born of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves Him who begot also loves him who is begotten of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has become a child of God. And everyone who loves the Father loves his children, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves the child born of Him.
verses.textEn: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.

verses.textZh: 我们若爱神，并且遵行他的命令，就知道我们是爱神的儿女了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若爱神，并且遵行他的命令，就知道我们是爱神的儿女了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若爱神，又遵守他的诫命，从此就知道我们爱神的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.
verses.textEnEsv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and obey his commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep His commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: We know we love God’s children if we love God and obey his commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and follow His commandments.
verses.textEn: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

verses.textZh: 我们遵守神的命令，就是爱他了；而且他的命令是不难遵守的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们遵守神的命令，就是爱他了；而且他的命令是不难遵守的，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们遵守神的诫命，这就是爱他了，并且他的诫命不是难守的。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not burdensome.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome.
verses.textEnNlt: Loving God means keeping his commandments, and his commandments are not burdensome.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments; and His commandments are not burdensome.
verses.textEn: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,

verses.textZh: 因为凡从神生的就胜过世界。使我们胜过世界的，就是我们的信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为凡从神生的就胜过世界。使我们胜过世界的，就是我们的信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为凡从神生的，就胜过世界；使我们胜了世界的，就是我们的信心。
verses.textEnNiv: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.
verses.textEnEsv: For everyone who has been born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world— our faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world—our faith.
verses.textEnNlt: For every child of God defeats this evil world, and we achieve this victory through our faith.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever has been born of God overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
verses.textEn: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

verses.textZh: 胜过世界的是谁呢？不就是那信耶稣是神的儿子的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 胜过世界的是谁呢？不就是那信耶稣是神的儿子的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 胜过世界的是谁呢？不是那信耶稣是神儿子的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is it that overcomes the world except the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.textEnNlt: And who can win this battle against the world? Only those who believe that Jesus is the Son of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Who is the one who overcomes the world, but the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.textEn: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.textZh: 那借着水和血来的就是耶稣基督，不是单用水，而是用水又用血；作见证的是圣灵，因为圣灵就是真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那借着水和血来的就是耶稣基督，不是单用水，而是用水又用血；作见证的是圣灵，因为圣灵就是真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 这藉着水和血而来的，就是耶稣基督；不是单用水，乃是用水又用血，
verses.textEnNiv: This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: This is he who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ; not by the water only but by the water and the blood. And the Spirit is the one who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is He who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ; not only by water, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus Christ was revealed as God’s Son by his baptism in water and by shedding his blood on the cross —not by water only, but by water and blood. And the Spirit, who is truth, confirms it with his testimony.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.textEn: This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

verses.textZh: 原来作见证的有三样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来作见证的有三样，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且有圣灵作见证，因为圣灵就是真理。
verses.textEnNiv: For there are three that testify:
verses.textEnEsv: For there are three that testify:
verses.textEnNkjv: For there are three that bear witness in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one.
verses.textEnNlt: So we have these three witnesses —
verses.textEnNasb: For there are three that testify:
verses.textEn: For there are three that testify:

verses.textZh: 就是圣灵、水和血，这三样是一致的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是圣灵、水和血，这三样是一致的。
verses.textZhCuv: 作见证的原来有三：就是圣灵、水，与血，这三样也都归于一。
verses.textEnNiv: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.
verses.textEnEsv: the Spirit and the water and the blood; and these three agree.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there are three that bear witness on earth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and these three agree as one.
verses.textEnNlt: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and all three agree.
verses.textEnNasb: the Spirit and the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.
verses.textEn: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.

verses.textZh: 我们若接受人的见证，神的见证就更强而有力了，因为这是神为他的儿子作的见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若接受人的见证，神的见证就更强而有力了，因为这是神为他的儿子作的见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既领受人的见证，神的见证更该领受 了，因神的见证是为他儿子作的。
verses.textEnNiv: We accept human testimony, but God’s testimony is greater because it is the testimony of God, which he has given about his Son.
verses.textEnEsv: If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater, for this is the testimony of God that he has borne concerning his Son.
verses.textEnNkjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is the witness of God which He has testified of His Son.
verses.textEnNlt: Since we believe human testimony, surely we can believe the greater testimony that comes from God. And God has testified about his Son.
verses.textEnNasb: If we receive the testimony of people, the testimony of God is greater; for the testimony of God is this, that He has testified concerning His Son.
verses.textEn: We accept human testimony, but God’s testimony is greater because it is the testimony of God, which he has given about his Son.

verses.textZh: 信神的儿子的，就有这见证在他心里；不信神的，就是把神当作说谎的，因为他不信神为他儿子所作的见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信神的儿子的，就有这见证在他心里；不信神的，就是把神当作说谎的，因为他不信神为他儿子所作的见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 信神儿子的，就有这见证在他心里；不信神的，就是将神当作说谎的，因不信神为他儿子作的见证。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever believes in the Son of God accepts this testimony. Whoever does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because they have not believed the testimony God has given about his Son.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. Whoever does not believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has borne concerning his Son.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who believes in the Son of God has the witness in himself; he who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed the testimony that God has given of His Son.
verses.textEnNlt: All who believe in the Son of God know in their hearts that this testimony is true. Those who don’t believe this are actually calling God a liar because they don’t believe what God has testified about his Son.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself; the one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning His Son.
verses.textEn: Whoever believes in the Son of God accepts this testimony. Whoever does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because they have not believed the testimony God has given about his Son.

verses.textZh: 这见证就是神已经把永远的生命赐给我们，这生命是在他儿子里面的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这见证就是神已经把永远的生命赐给我们，这生命是在他儿子里面的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这见证就是神赐给我们永生；这永生也是在他儿子里面。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the testimony, that God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the testimony: that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is what God has testified: He has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.textEnNasb: And the testimony is this, that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
verses.textEn: And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

verses.textZh: 凡有神儿子的，就有生命；没有神儿子的，就没有生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有神儿子的，就有生命；没有神儿子的，就没有生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 人有了神的儿子就有生命，没有神的儿子就没有生命。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has the Son has life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
verses.textEnNlt: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have God’s Son does not have life.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has the Son has the life; the one who does not have the Son of God does not have the life.
verses.textEn: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

verses.textZh: 我把这些事写给你们信神的儿子之名的人，是要你们知道自己有永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把这些事写给你们信神的儿子之名的人，是要你们知道自己有永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将这些话写给你们信奉神儿子之名的人，要叫你们知道自己有永生。
verses.textEnNiv: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continueto believe in the name of the Son of God.
verses.textEnNlt: I have written this to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know you have eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
verses.textEn: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.

verses.textZh: 如果我们照着神的旨意祈求，他必听我们；这就是我们对神所存的坦然无惧的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们照着神的旨意祈求，他必听我们；这就是我们对神所存的坦然无惧的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若照他的旨意求什么，他就听我们，这是我们向他所存坦然无惧的心。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the confidence that we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will he hears us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the confidence that we have in Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
verses.textEnNlt: And we are confident that he hears us whenever we ask for anything that pleases him.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the confidence which we have before Him, that, if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
verses.textEn: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

verses.textZh: 既然我们知道他听我们的祈求，我们就知道，我们无论求甚么，他必赐给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然我们知道他听我们的祈求，我们就知道，我们无论求甚么，他必赐给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 既然知道他听我们一切所求的，就知道我们所求于他的，无不得着。
verses.textEnNiv: And if we know that he hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of him.
verses.textEnEsv: And if we know that he hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests that we have asked of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if we know that He hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we have asked of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And since we know he hears us when we make our requests, we also know that he will give us what we ask for.
verses.textEnNasb: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests which we have asked from Him.
verses.textEn: And if we know that he hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of him.

verses.textZh: 如果有人看见弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，他就要祈求，神必因他的缘故，把生命赐给那些犯了不至于死的罪的人；有至于死的罪，我不说他应当为那罪祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人看见弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，他就要祈求，神必因他的缘故，把生命赐给那些犯了不至于死的罪的人；有至于死的罪，我不说他应当为那罪祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若看见弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，就当为他祈求，神必将生命赐给他；有至于死的罪，我不说当为这罪祈求。
verses.textEnNiv: If you see any brother or sister commit a sin that does not lead to death, you should pray and God will give them life. I refer to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying that you should pray about that.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life—to those who commit sins that do not lead to death. There is sin that leads to death; I do not say that one should pray for that.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin whichdoes not lead to death, he will ask, and He will give him life for those who commit sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I do not say that he should pray about that.
verses.textEnNlt: If you see a fellow believer sinning in a way that does not lead to death, you should pray, and God will give that person life. But there is a sin that leads to death, and I am not saying you should pray for those who commit it.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone sees his brother or sister committing a sin not leading to death, he shall ask and God will, for him, give life to those who commit sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death; I am not saying that he should ask about that.
verses.textEn: If you see any brother or sister commit a sin that does not lead to death, you should pray and God will give them life. I refer to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying that you should pray about that.

verses.textZh: 一切不义都是罪，但也有不至于死的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切不义都是罪，但也有不至于死的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不义的事都是罪，也有不至于死的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.
verses.textEnEsv: All wrongdoing is sin, but there is sin that does not lead to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
verses.textEnNlt: All wicked actions are sin, but not every sin leads to death.
verses.textEnNasb: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
verses.textEn: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.

verses.textZh: 我们知道凡从神生的就不犯罪，而且从神生的那一位也必保守他，连那恶者也不能碰他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道凡从神生的就不犯罪，而且从神生的那一位也必保守他，连那恶者也不能碰他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们知道凡从神生的，必不犯罪，从神生的，必保守自己 ，那恶者也就无法害他。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the One who was born of God keeps them safe, and the evil one cannot harm them.
verses.textEnEsv: We know that everyone who has been born of God does not keep on sinning, but he who was born of God protects him, and the evil one does not touch him.
verses.textEnNkjv: We know that whoever is born of God does not sin; but he who has been born of God keeps himself, and the wicked one does not touch him.
verses.textEnNlt: We know that God’s children do not make a practice of sinning, for God’s Son holds them securely, and the evil one cannot touch them.
verses.textEnNasb: We know that no one who has been born of God sins; but He who was born of God keeps him, and the evil one does not touch him.
verses.textEn: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the One who was born of God keeps them safe, and the evil one cannot harm them.

verses.textZh: 我们知道我们是属于神的，而整个世界是伏在那恶者手下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道我们是属于神的，而整个世界是伏在那恶者手下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们知道，我们是属神的，全世界都卧在那恶者手下。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.
verses.textEnEsv: We know that we are from God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
verses.textEnNkjv: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies undertheswayof the wicked one.
verses.textEnNlt: We know that we are children of God and that the world around us is under the control of the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
verses.textEn: We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.

verses.textZh: 我们知道神的儿子已经来了，并且赐给我们悟性，使我们能认识那位真实者。我们也在那位真实者里面，就是在他儿子耶稣基督里面。这一位就是真神，也是永远的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道神的儿子已经来了，并且赐给我们悟性，使我们能认识那位真实者。我们也在那位真实者里面，就是在他儿子耶稣基督里面。这一位就是真神，也是永远的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们也知道，神的儿子已经来到，且将智慧赐给我们，使我们认识那位真实的，我们也在那位真实的里面，就是在他儿子耶稣基督里面。这是真神，也是永生。
verses.textEnNiv: We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true. And we are in him who is true by being in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: And we know that the Son of God has come, and he has given us understanding so that we can know the true God. And now we live in fellowship with the true God because we live in fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the only true God, and he is eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: And we know that the Son of God has come, and has given us understanding so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
verses.textEn: We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true. And we are in him who is true by being in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

verses.textZh: 孩子们，你们要保守自己远离偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们，你们要保守自己远离偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像！
verses.textEnNiv: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
verses.textEnEsv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear children, keep away from anything that might take God’s place in your hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Little children, guard yourselves from idols.
verses.textEn: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
